description: This is a Python source file implementing a custom observer class for logging specific audio frame events, setting up a pipeline for a conversational bot with speech-to-text, language model, and text-to-speech services, and managing transport connections and event handlers for a Pipecat-based WebRTC call system.

classes.name: CustomObserver
classes.description: A custom observer class that logs interruption and bot speaking events to the console during a pipeline execution.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Handles frame push events, logs specific frame types with source, destination, and timestamp information.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot process.
